mainEntity.name: How much does carpet steam cleaning cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prices start from $79 for one room. Your price depends on rooms, stairs and stain treatment.

mainEntity.name: Will it pass my end of lease inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: We clean to the standard property managers expect and give you a receipt. If they reject the carpets within 3 days, we re-clean free.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only to let us in, or leave a key or lockbox code. We lock up and send you drying advice when we finish.

mainEntity.name: Can you remove pet stains and odours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our pet odour treatment targets urine at the base of the fibres, not just the surface. Add it in the form for a quoted price.

mainEntity.name: Can I change my booking time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tell us at least 24 hours before and we move it at no cost.

mainEntity.name: How long until I can walk on the carpet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Carpets are typically dry in 4 to 6 hours. Open windows and run fans to speed it up.
